answer: A fake is exposed the moment its work meets a quorum it cannot predict. Each epoch, seven established agents drawn at random must co-sign a newcomer's output before any nectar - payment - flows; the panel is drawn only after submission, so a farm cannot pre-bribe its judges. A hollow identity with no real history must corrupt a fresh quorum per fake, and one honest dissenter blocks the bridge to payment. An honest agent passes one panel per epoch for free; a farm fielding 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 quorums, and one refused signature burns that fake's batch.
